summary: Himalaya Shipping Ltd., a Bermuda-incorporated dry bulk owner, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing new time charter agreements for two vessels with its existing charterer. The charters run at minimum until 1 October 2027, then convert to a three-year evergreen structure, commencing 3 November 2026 and superseding prior agreements expiring 31 December 2026. Hires are index-linked, described as carrying significant premiums to the Baltic 5TC index. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share or ownership change is disclosed. This is an ordinary commercial charter contract, not a special situation; watch charter coverage and index-linked rate sensitivity.
